description: A tape dispenser sits near the top of the bed, with a long pink-and-purple beaded string laid out and a pile of loose colorful beads on the right. The right hand reaches into the bead pile to pick up a bead, then moves left toward the string while the left hand holds and steadies the string end; both hands come together around the string as the right hand threads the bead on and slides it along, then the left hand pulls the string slightly left as the right hand lifts and repositions near the bead pile to continue.
